summary: The maintenance-index lookup now uses the matching-refs listing and returns null only for a successful empty array, so a verified absence releases the follow while transport failures, non-200 responses, non-array bodies, non-exact ref identity and non-commit targets throw FollowError and keep the follow deferred. The added tests cover both the verified-absence release and the unreadable variants. No actionable defects found.

evidence: src/host/hosted-runtime-follow-matrix.ts:76-90 replaces the swallowed exact-ref read with /git/matching-refs; only an empty array returns null and every other response or transport error throws FollowError.
src/host/hosted-runtime-follow.ts:199-210 maps a thrown FollowError to a deferred journal, so transport and HTTP failures hold the follow before any launcher write.
tests/host/hosted-runtime-follow_test.ts:476-489 asserts the follow still advances when matching-refs verifies an empty index ref list.
tests/host/hosted-runtime-follow_test.ts:491-521 asserts deferred with zero mutations for transport, 401/403/404/429/500, malformed, null and wrong-ref responses.
